decision: REJECTED; keep current source and all distributions unchanged.
reason: No consistent large-input or exact-main benefit. Identical-baseline controls show bimodal timings; isolated small-input gains do not establish a generally useful improvement. SKIP empty input also adds an unnecessary allocation.
scope: Only SKIP LCPArray rank storage: vector<int>(n) -> make_unique_for_overwrite<int[]>(n), plus memory include. Checked rank(n,-1), algorithm, output vector, APIs, driver main, and common fastIO remain unchanged.

correctness.reference: Small independently sorted suffix arrays + direct adjacent-prefix comparison for random byte strings and signed integer vectors; empty/1/2/63/64/65/127 boundaries. Large random direct-prefix oracle; uniform and7-periodic closed form.
correctness.ownership: Returned vector deep-copy/move checked. Both nonempty allocation failure points, input preservation, and throwing sequence comparison release all temporary allocations back to pre-call live count.
